alert.suspended: This organization is suspended. Records and documents remain stored. Operations for this organization are unavailable until the super administrator restores access. Another active organization of the same user is not affected. This is not a communication failure, module block, or plan restriction.
alert.comm_detail: Could not verify the organization status. It has not been confirmed as active and no block has been cleared.
alert.session_detail: The query did not identify a valid operational session. This can occur with a blocked user or ended session. This is not a communication failure and does not confirm the organization as active.
alert.access_detail: The link with this organization may be blocked or the permission is insufficient. Another organization of the same user remains independent. Enabling a module does not remove suspension or plan restriction.
alert.module_blocked: A module is blocked by administration. Data remains. Enabling the module does not remove suspension or plan restriction.
alert.plan_restricted: A feature is outside the current plan. This is different from an administrative block or lack of permission.
